thread:
Olivia: Heads up 52 got invoice INV-9001 from LogiServe with sales tax charged for TX and NY. They attached NY resale cert but nothing for TX. Invoice total $15,000, tax lines: NY $600, TX $1,237.50. PO 55443. PDF: https://invoices.example.com/INV-9001.pdf

Marcus: Do we have nexus in TX for services? I thought our usage there was minimal but infra spin-ups last quarter might create nexus. Need to confirm tax nexus before we ask vendor to reissue.

Kelly: AP: hold payment until we sort. If vendor can show they billed based on ship-to or place-of-performance outside TX we can argue no TX tax. Otherwise request a TX exemption cert.

Olivia: Vendor message: "We applied tax because billing address shown as Redwood US (TX). We have NY resale cert on file (RS-78901) but you never provided TX exemption." They offered to reissue net if we provide valid TX exemption or proof of interstate resale.

Marcus: TaxOps: quick check 52 are our customers in TX driving sufficient economic nexus? Also, for resale certs TX requires purchaser exemption certificate (ST-XXXX). Do we have any statewide blanket certificate?

Kelly: We don't have a blanket TX cert on vendor master. We do have NY resale for a few vendors. For marketplace/service vendors it's tricky. Suggest path: 1) TaxOps confirms nexus exposure. 2) If no nexus, request vendor reissue net and annotate that service delivered interstate. 3) If nexus exists, ask vendor to reissue with correct tax registration and we accept tax or request credit if vendor agrees.

tax-bot: Event: invoice_hold placed (invoice=INV-9001, reason=multi_state_tax_dispute)

Marcus: Also consider use tax exposure if vendor won't reverse. If services are consumed in TX and we have nexus, we may owe use tax even if vendor incorrectly charged. TaxOps to advise on whether we should self-assess.

Olivia: I'll ask vendor for reissue pending TX exemption or their breakdown of tax jurisdiction. AP will keep on hold.

Kelly: For audit: capture vendor correspondence, the NY resale cert, and any decision memo from TaxOps. Also add a task to require TX-specific exemption evidence for any vendor charging TX tax in future.

Olivia: Vendor replied: "We can reissue net for NY only; TX tax will remain unless you provide TX exemption or confirm no TX nexus." They've requested our TX tax contact. I'll loop in TaxOps.

Marcus: I'll run nexus scan and update in 2 hours. If no nexus, AP to request reissue and release payment. If nexus, we'll accept tax and reconcile via use tax process. Closing for now.
